_comment: Delivery schedule for the emailed digest. Edit this file (GitHub's web editor works) and commit — the daily workflow reads it. There is no server, so this replaces the in-dashboard Schedule tab.
_days: weekly only. Any of MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT SUN, evaluated in IST. THU is deliberate: Google lands ~2 days behind and Bing ~4-5, so Thursday is the first day the whole Mon-Sun week that just ended is actually complete in BigQuery. Moving this earlier means emailing a week that is still filling in.
_dayOfMonth: monthly and quarterly only. 1-28, so it never skips a short month.
_recipients: Comma-separated. Falls back to the MAIL_TO secret when empty.
_alwaysEmailWhenOverBudget: Send outside the schedule if any product is projected over this percentage. Set to 0 to disable.
